items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 9:1
items.html: The separation of the bottom Hey from the vessels that fell into BYA is called Gazar [cutting], from the language of the verse, “To Him who cut the Red Sea into parts.” The whole of the correction depends upon this separation. (p. 601, Item 4)
